responsibility: Defines the main target configuration header for the M32R port. It supplies driver specs and preprocessor builtins, endianness and CPU-family selection macros, register-file and calling-convention constants, storage-layout and addressing macros, assembler output conventions, section and small-data emission rules, debug-format defaults, loop/alignment policies, machine modes such as Pmode/FUNCTION_MODE, and target-specific enums like m32r_function_type that parameterize both generic GCC code and the M32R backend implementation.
same_name_distinction: Target configuration header for M32R: unlike m32r.cc it defines compile-time macros, specs, register/layout constants, and ABI configuration rather than implementing hook logic; unlike m32r.md it does not encode RTL instruction patterns or scheduling automata; and unlike m32r.opt it provides the macro/enumeration interface that backend code and options rely on rather than declaring command-line options themselves.
